description: This file defines classes and enums related to network connectivity management, including endpoint caching, connectivity testing, and monitoring for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: EndpointManager
classes.description: Manages saving and loading network endpoints to and from a cache file.

classes.name: TestConnectivity
classes.description: Performs connectivity tests to specified endpoints and checks for captive portal presence.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: Monitors network connectivity status, manages endpoints, and detects internet state changes.

methods.name: writeEndpointsToFile
methods.description: Writes a list of endpoints to the cache file.

methods.name: readEndpointsFromFile
methods.description: Reads endpoints from the cache file.

methods.name: setConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Sets the endpoints used for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getConnectivityMonitorEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of endpoints used for connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns the current list of connectivity monitor endpoints.

methods.name: getCaptivePortal
methods.description: Returns the URI of the detected captive portal.

methods.name: getInternetState
methods.description: Returns the current internet connectivity status.

methods.name: checkCurlResponse
methods.description: Performs a curl request to check internet connectivity.

methods.name: checkInternetStateFromResponseCode
methods.description: Determines internet state from HTTP response codes.

methods.name: connectivityMonitorFunction
methods.description: Main loop function for network connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: notifyInternetStatusChangedEvent
methods.description: Triggers event notification on internet status change.
